purpose: Baseline input provenance only; not Golden, parity or support evidence. All 94 routes declare one kind. Derived operations execute in list order: copy half-open repository-artifact ranges to targetOrder offsets in the prepared input file, or apply declared fill/literal bytes; copyCount equals targetOrder length. No firmware-field interpretation. Synthetic patterns use (seed + index * step) modulo 256 and ordered literal overlays. CLI/Application own all Merge/Replace, bank, CRC/header and naming logic. Generated inputs exist only in the external test area.
